name: Look To The Stars
summary: Following the blueprints provided by the tinker Cog, Viktori Prism'Antras seeks a reflective surface to assemble his observatory telescope in Darkshire. He directs travelers to southern Duskwood to locate Mary, a local woman remembered for carrying a looking glass.

sections.title: A Reflective Surface
sections.body: Having secured a bronze tube for his telescope, Viktori Prism'Antras turns to the next requirement outlined in Cog's blueprints: a reliable mirror to direct and reflect light through the device. Rather than forging fine silvered glass from scratch amidst the shortages plaguing Darkshire, Viktori recalls Mary, a local resident known across the region for always carrying a looking glass.

sections.title: Searching the South
sections.body: Mary's former residence lies deep in southern Duskwood, just north of the haunted Tranquil Gardens Cemetery. Seeking her out takes adventurers past the safe patrol borders of the Night Watch and into blighted groves teeming with ravenous wolves, feral spiders, and wandering undead.

sections.title: A Tragic Resident
sections.body: Reaching Mary's humble southern shack reveals the bleak reality of Duskwood's fall. The woman Viktori remembered is no longer a living resident, but Blind Mary—a wandering spirit lingering near her old dwelling and the nearby cemetery, tethered to the memories and possessions of her former life.

faq.answer: Viktori is constructing an astronomical telescope in his hut up the hill in Darkshire, working off designs drawn up by a tinker named Cog.

faq.q: Why does Viktori need a looking glass?
faq.answer: Cog's optical blueprints require a mirror to reflect and focus light through the telescope housing. Viktori remembers Mary carrying a looking glass and hopes to acquire it for the assembly.
Mary resides in a ruined home in southeastern Duskwood, situated just north of the Tranquil Gardens Cemetery.

Mary was a resident of southern Duskwood before the land fell into cursed darkness, well known around Darkshire for always carrying a looking glass. What became of her is something you must discover at her old home near Tranquil Gardens Cemetery.

faq.q: Does Mary still have her looking glass?
faq.answer: When approached, Mary acknowledges that she once owned a looking glass, though she no longer has it and can only point you toward where it went.
The southeastern woods and the adjacent Tranquil Gardens Cemetery crawl with hostile undead, feral duskbats, venom web spiders, and rabid wolves that prey upon travelers venturing south of Darkshire.

angles.text: Helping Viktori build his telescope offers a rare glimmer of curiosity and progress in a town otherwise consumed by terror and rot.
Telescope assembly relies on precise optical specifications, borrowing from gnomish blueprints to mirror and magnify faint starlight.
